known_limitations: ILLUSTRATIVE IMPUTED-REVENUE SENSITIVITY ONLY. This is not an actionable fair-value estimate or an investment recommendation.

Production is used solely as the company-style imputed-revenue proxy (100% produced tin sold/paid); it is NOT reported payable sales. The workbook labels it production_tonnes_proxy. Realized payable sales, inventory, settlement timing and revenue must replace this proxy before valuation.

The baseline price AUD63,760/t is the reported trailing-12-month LME-imputed price, NOT realized tin sales price. Scenario price and volume levels are analyst stress assumptions, not company guidance.

Unit cost combines reported trailing-12-month C1 AUD19,349/t and imputed sales/marketing AUD8,089/t. Marketing includes royalties and payable-tin deductions, so separate royalty_rate=0 prevents duplicate deductions. Price-linked marketing behavior is not separately modelled and could materially affect sensitivity.

Finite horizons 3/5/7 years remain stress assumptions, not reserve-supported remaining life. August interim report confirms approximately nine-year reserve life on March 2025 basis, and 10.9-year LOMP including inferred material. Neither is nine years remaining from September 2026. Updated 2026 plan expected Q3; not yet captured. No perpetuity.

Cash 373.998m, interest-bearing liabilities 1.100m and issued shares 886,392,538 now share June 30 2026 reporting date. Shares correct a prior 1,000-share transcription error. No current securities reconciliation or post-June cash roll-forward; issued shares remain a diluted-share proxy.

Closure is an explicit assumed AUD100m whole-operation nominal final-year payment. The June 2026 reported AUD34.480m group rehabilitation provision is a present-value accounting figure, not this cash-payment estimate; actual scope/timing and other closure sites remain unmodelled.

Capex annualizes June-quarter whole-operation AUD23.4m to AUD93.6m each model year, including both sustaining and project spend. This is a scenario assumption, not guidance. No additional AISC deduction is made.

Annual corporate costs annualize group June-quarter AUD0.56m to AUD2.24m, deducted once after 50% attribution. Other investments/residual assets are set to zero only to exclude them from this limited sensitivity, not because they have zero economic value.

Tax rate30% is an analyst simplifying assumption; depreciation is assumed zero and no loss carryforwards, corporate tax shields or closure deductions are modelled. No forecast working-capital changes are assumed; this is not verified operational guidance.

Selected FY2024/FY2025 and H1 2025/H1 2026 actuals included. Half-years are not annual periods. Reported group actuals are already attributable; do not apply 50% again. These are selected historical observations, not integrated forecast statements.

August interim moves Rentails FEED/permitting expectation to late CY2026 and FID to CY2027. No sanctioned current capex/financing plan captured; Rentails valuation excluded. The historical cash bridge includes strategic investments; no cash is assumed freely distributable.

Dated delayed reference quote AUD2.15 at 18 September 2026 16:10 AEST, from Stock Analysis/S&P Global. Quote context does not turn illustrative values into price targets. June issued shares remain a diluted-share proxy; no complete post-June securities reconciliation.

First annual period now includes a 6/5/4-week bear/base/bull shutdown sensitivity from the disclosed Q1 2027 hoist works. Lost output with no recovery is an analyst stress, not guidance: stockpile feed/catch-up could reduce the loss. Annual operating cost held fixed, increasing per-tonne cost. Later periods retain earlier run-rate proxies.

Annual periods 2027 onward are simplified period-end flows discounted one year onward; no remaining-2026 stub or exact monthly cash timing. Selected historical lines and operating data do not establish a supported payable-sales forecast.
